description: Use this when the person asks to change a Pugi website or app from this conversation: "change the headline", "make the buttons green", "add a menu page". Pass the change in the customer's own words; do not add features the customer did not ask for (no invented sign-up, accounts, subscriptions or payments). Pass the job_id or project_id from the last build result. Do not use to start a new site or app. In hosts that render the build card (MCP Apps or ChatGPT widget), the card tracks progress automatically: do not poll job_status. In hosts without a build card (Claude Code or API), call job_status with the job_id until the job is finished, stopped or failed.

brief_confirmed.description: True only after the person has seen the summary and agreed. In a chat, without it nothing starts and the summary comes back.

brief_version.description: With brief_confirmed: the version of the summary the person agreed to, as returned with that summary.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string naming this job. The same key returns the same job and is never charged twice.

instruction.description: The change to make, in plain words.

job_id.description: The job_id of the build (or of an earlier edit) of the site to change.

language.description: The language the person is writing in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "ru".

max_usd.description: The run ceiling in USD; plan edits are included in the subscription. For credit edits, the most this change may cost. Default 2.

project_id.description: Or the project_id of that site.

site_language.description: Language for the website content; independent of the chat card language.

without_logo.description: True only when the person said this site should not use the logo they picked.

name: edit
title: Change a site Pugi built
